LanguageData.PWM_Settings_Intro: Changes apply to existing washing machines immediately. Each cycle takes 30 game seconds.
LanguageData.PWM_Settings_PowerTip: Set power consumption from 0 to 1000 W. Default: 200 W.
LanguageData.PWM_Settings_MaxBodySizeTip: Creatures at or below this body size can be carried into a washing machine. Range: 0.1–10. Default: 0.95.
LanguageData.PWM_Settings_DeathChanceTip: Creatures with a body size strictly below 0.25 can die after washing. Range: 0–100%. Default: 5%.
